title: salix udensis subsp. opaca
intro: Salix udensis subsp. opaca, commonly known as Korean white willow, is a subspecies of the Salix udensis plant, which is native to East Asia and belongs to the willow family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Korean white willow include its ability to inhibit the production of prostaglandins, a type of hormone that can cause pain and inflammation, as well as its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Salix udensis subsp. opaca include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, which is responsible for its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
